tagline.zh: 趨勢不是最後一筆，停下來的三十秒最值錢
tagline.en: A trend is not the last reading, and the thirty seconds you stop are worth the most

desc.zh: 跟著柯學姊給藥、換藥、接 ISBAR、回報病況；條碼掃不過的時候，決定的人是你。
desc.en: Give medicines and change dressings with Nurse Ko, take the ISBAR handover, report deterioration; when the barcode will not scan, the decision is yours.

desc.zh: 翻身、洗手、推急救車、陪家屬；病人身上最早的變化你最先摸到。
desc.en: Turning, hand hygiene, the crash cart and the families are yours; you are the first to feel a change in a patient.

about.zh: 十五年病房資歷。永遠在找她的筆，永遠借你的。
about.en: Fifteen years on the wards. Forever looking for her pen, forever borrowing yours.

about.zh: 整個病房的節拍器。急救車封條號碼她背得出來。
about.en: The ward's metronome. Knows the crash cart seal number by heart.

about.zh: 被叫來的時候先說「說」。喜歡聽到完整的 ISBAR。
about.en: Arrives saying “Go.” Likes a complete ISBAR.

about.zh: 每天中午帶著兩份清單出現。他看得到系統裡每一筆手動覆寫。
about.en: Appears every noon with two lists. He can see every manual override in the system.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。還不太能動，手卻沒停過：用藥袋紙摺紙鶴。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Cannot move much yet, but his hands never stop: he folds paper cranes from medicine bags.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。兩份用藥清單，一袋家裡的藥。說話輕，變化也輕。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Two medication lists and a bag from home. Speaks softly; deteriorates softly too.

about.zh: 帶了一台家用血壓計，量了兩次，得到兩個答案。
about.en: Brought a home blood pressure machine, measured twice, got two answers.

about.zh: 交班一定用 ISBAR，講完一定要你複誦。
about.en: Always hands over in ISBAR and always waits for your read-back.

plain.zh: 每次給藥都要對的五件事：病人對、藥物對、劑量對、途徑對、時間對；很多單位加上記錄對。
plain.en: Five things to confirm at every medicine round: right patient, drug, dose, route and time; many units add right documentation.

plain.zh: 病人手腕上的身分帶，印著姓名、病歷號與條碼；核對身分的第一個依據。
plain.en: The identity band on a patient's wrist with name, record number and barcode; the first basis for checking identity.

plain.zh: 掃手圈與藥袋上的條碼，系統自動核對病人與藥；掃不過就是停下來的訊號。
plain.en: Scanning the band and the medicine label lets the system match patient and drug; a failed scan is the signal to stop.

plain.zh: 換藥、打針時保護「關鍵部位」不被碰到的一套做法，不需要整個無菌環境。
plain.en: A way of protecting the “key parts” from being touched during dressings and injections, without needing a fully sterile field.

plain.zh: 會直接接觸傷口或進入身體的部分：敷料內面、針頭、接頭。只能碰無菌的。
plain.en: The parts that will touch the wound or enter the body: the inside of a dressing, needle tips, connectors. Only sterile touches sterile.

plain.zh: 長時間壓迫讓皮膚和底下組織缺血受傷；骨頭突出處最常見。
plain.en: Damage to skin and the tissue beneath from prolonged pressure cutting off blood flow; bony prominences are the usual sites.

plain.zh: 一段時間內數值的走向。最後一筆正常，不代表前幾個小時也正常。
plain.en: The direction readings take over time. A normal last reading says nothing about the hours before it.

plain.zh: 交班與回報的固定順序：身分、情境、背景、評估、建議，最後複誦。
plain.en: The fixed order for handover and escalation: Identity, Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation, then read back.

plain.zh: 把聽到的內容重複一遍給對方確認，電話交班與口頭醫囑都要。
plain.en: Repeating what you heard back to the speaker; required for telephone handovers and verbal orders.

plain.zh: 血壓計綁在上臂的那一圈；太小會量出偏高，手臂位置也會影響數值。
plain.en: The band of the blood pressure machine around the upper arm; too small reads high, and arm position changes the number.

plain.zh: 指夾感測器讀出的血液帶氧比例；下降時先看病人，再看機器。
plain.en: The finger-clip reading of how much oxygen the blood carries; when it drops, look at the patient before the machine.

plain.zh: 裝著急救藥物與器材的推車，封條完整、每天檢查，所有人都要知道它在哪裡。
plain.en: The trolley holding emergency drugs and equipment; seal intact, checked daily, and everyone knows where it is.

plain.zh: 把差點出錯或已出錯的事寫下來交給單位，目的是讓系統改善，不是處罰個人。
plain.en: Writing up a near miss or an error for the unit, so the system can improve; it is not about punishing a person.

plain.zh: 把所有來源的藥單和實際吃法對成一份正確清單，轉床、入院、出院時都要做。
plain.en: Matching every medicine list and the actual use into one correct list; done on every transfer, admission and discharge.

text.zh: 一床一格、上鎖、掃描器掛在側邊。五對從推車開始。
text.en: One drawer per bed, locked, scanner on the side. The five rights begin at the cart.

text.zh: 掃手圈、掃藥袋，系統核對。掃不過不是故障，是停下來的提示。
text.en: Scan the band, scan the label, the system matches them. A failed scan is not a fault; it is a prompt to stop.

text.zh: 封條號碼、檢查表、每日簽名。模擬演練時推它的人，真的時候也推它。
text.en: Seal number, checklist, daily signature. Whoever pushes it in the drill pushes it for real.

text.zh: 休息後量、坐好、手臂與心臟同高、袖帶合尺寸。兩個數字都記，條件也記。
text.en: After rest, seated, arm at heart level, correctly sized cuff. Record both numbers, and the conditions.

text.zh: 打開的順序就是無菌的順序。關鍵部位只碰無菌的。
text.en: The order you open it is the order of asepsis. Key parts touch only sterile.

text.zh: 床號、重點、待辦、通知了誰。寫了名字的待辦才會有人做。
text.en: Bed, key points, to-dos, who was told. A to-do with a name on it gets done.

text.zh: 阿雄伯用藥袋紙摺的。翅膀上還印著「飯後」。
text.en: Folded by Uncle Hsiung from a medicine bag. One wing still says “after meals”.

text.zh: 五對是流程，停下來是文化。條碼掃不過、名字不對、藥長得不一樣，都是停下來的理由。
text.en: The five rights are a process; stopping is a culture. A failed scan, a wrong name or a tablet that looks different are all reasons to stop.

text.zh: 身分、情境、背景、評估、建議。評估要講趨勢，建議要講你要對方做什麼。
text.en: Identity, Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation. Assessment gives the trend; Recommendation says what you want the listener to do.

note.zh: 交班：趨勢與一通 ICU 電話
note.en: Handover: the trend and a call from ICU

lines.zh: 外科病房，早上七點。交班板前站了一排人，柯學姊在找她的筆。
lines.en: The surgical ward, seven in the morning. A row of people at the board; Nurse Ko is looking for her pen.

lines.zh: 筆借我。今天你跟我：7 床阿雄伯、12 床秀英姨。
lines.en: Lend me your pen. You're with me today: bed 7, Uncle Hsiung; bed 12, Auntie Hsiu-Ying.

lines.zh: 12 床早上從 ICU 轉來，ICU 等一下會打來交班。
lines.en: Bed 12 came up from ICU this morning; they'll ring to hand over shortly.

lines.zh: 交班單只印最後一筆。病人不是只有最後一筆。先看趨勢。
lines.en: The handover sheet prints only the last reading. A patient is more than a last reading. Look at the trend first.

guide.zh: 到護理站接 ICU 電話
guide.en: Take the ICU call at the station

lines.zh: 我用 ISBAR 交。準備好了嗎？
lines.en: I'll hand over in ISBAR. Ready?

lines.zh: 好了，請說。
lines.en: Ready, go ahead.

q.zh: 接收 ISBAR 交班的順序
q.en: The order of an ISBAR handover

steps.en: Identity: patient, bed, who is handing over
Situation: reason for transfer and current state

post.zh: 複誦正確。還有，她家裡的藥袋和我們的清單不一樣，兒子帶來了。
post.en: Read-back correct. One more thing: her medicines from home don't match our list. Her son brought them in.

post.zh: 記下來，中午請藥師一起對。
post.en: Noted. The pharmacist and I will reconcile them at noon.

note.zh: 給藥五對；一個掃不過的條碼
note.en: Five rights; one barcode that would not scan

guide.en: Start the round at the cart

lines.zh: 給藥五對。你說。
lines.en: The five rights. Say them.

lines.zh: 病人對、藥物對、劑量對、途徑對、時間對。
lines.en: Right patient, right drug, right dose, right route, right time.

lines.zh: 第六對：記錄對。推車走。
lines.en: Sixth right: right documentation. Push the cart.

steps.zh: 核對病人：姓名、病歷號、手圈
steps.en: Confirm the patient: name, record number, wristband
Match the drug to the order

post.zh: 每一對都是一次停下來的機會。
post.en: Every right is a chance to stop.

lines.zh: 你掃阿雄伯的手圈。嗶。再掃。嗶。條碼掃不過。
lines.en: You scan Uncle Hsiung's wristband. Beep. Again. Beep. The barcode will not scan.

lines.zh: 昨天擦澡弄濕了啦。我是阿雄沒錯。
lines.en: It got wet in the bed bath yesterday. I'm Hsiung, honest.

q.en: The barcode will not scan. What do you do?

options.zh: 停下，口頭核對兩項身分，換新手圈再給
options.en: Stop, verify two identifiers verbally, replace the band, then give

why.zh: 掃不過是停下來的訊號，不是繞過去的理由。
why.en: A failed scan is a signal to stop, not a reason to go around.

options.zh: 手動輸入病歷號繼續給
options.en: Type the record number manually and carry on

why.zh: 手動覆寫跳過了系統最後一道防線。
why.en: A manual override skips the system's last line of defence.

options.zh: 先給藥，等一下回來補掃

why.zh: 先給再補，就是沒有核對。
why.en: Give first and check later is no check at all.

post.zh: 停下來的那三十秒，比什麼都值錢。
post.en: Those thirty seconds you stop are worth more than anything.

lines.zh: 阿雄伯，兩個小時到了，翻身囉。床頭搖低、拉單、兩個人一起。
lines.en: Uncle Hsiung, two hours are up, time to turn. Head of the bed down, draw sheet, two of us together.

lines.zh: 你們比鬧鐘還準。
lines.en: You lot are more punctual than my alarm clock.

lines.zh: 翻身表上簽名、寫時間、寫方向。
lines.en: Sign the turning chart: time and which side.

lines.zh: 給完立刻記。記錄不是給自己看的，是給下一班看的。
lines.en: Document the moment you give. The record is not for you; it is for the next shift.

lines.zh: 時間、藥名、途徑、簽名。還有剛才換手圈的事。
lines.en: Time, drug, route, signature. And the replaced wristband.

note.zh: 換藥完成；皮膚觀察有時間有部位
note.en: Dressing done; skin check with time and site

lines.zh: 無菌非觸碰技術。關鍵部位是什麼？
lines.en: Aseptic non-touch technique. What are the key parts?

lines.zh: 敷料內面、傷口、任何會碰到傷口的東西。
lines.en: The inside of the dressing, the wound, anything that will touch the wound.

lines.zh: 對。洗手、鋪盤、不碰關鍵部位。開始。
lines.en: Right. Hands, field, never touch a key part. Go.

post.en: You change dressings like you're unwrapping presents.

lines.zh: 換藥我來，你準備推車、洗手，然後幫我扶阿雄伯。
lines.en: I'll do the dressing. You set up the trolley, wash your hands, then help me hold Uncle Hsiung.

post.zh: 洗完手不碰別的東西，直接過來。
post.en: Hands washed, touch nothing else, straight over.

lines.zh: 換完藥，看尾椎和腳跟。夜班傳了一張照片，紅紅的一塊。
lines.en: Dressing done, now the tailbone and heels. Nights sent a photo: a red patch.

lines.zh: 照片沒寫部位、時間、大小。
lines.en: The photo has no site, no time, no size.

lines.zh: 那就不算評估。先補足觀察條件。
lines.en: Then it is not an assessment. Fill in the observation conditions first.

post.zh: 壓力性損傷的照片要有尺、有部位、有時間，壓下去會不會變白也要寫。
post.en: A pressure injury photo needs a ruler, a site, a time, and whether it blanches.

lines.zh: 躺著跟坐著，壓的地方不一樣。看圖。
lines.en: Lying and sitting load different places. Look.

question.zh: 哪些部位最容易發生壓力性損傷？
question.en: Which sites are most prone to pressure injury?

answer.zh: 骨頭突出、肉少的地方：薦骨尾椎、腳跟、坐骨、股骨大轉子、肩胛、後腦。躺著和坐著的好發點不同。
answer.en: Bony, poorly padded places: sacrum and tailbone, heels, ischial tuberosities, greater trochanters, shoulder blades, back of the head. Lying and sitting have different hot spots.

post.zh: 翻身表上每一格都是一次預防。
post.en: Every box on the turning chart is one prevention.

note.zh: 用藥整合；兩個血壓數字

guide.en: Meet Wei the pharmacist at the cart

lines.zh: 12 床，兩份清單、一袋家裡的藥。用藥整合開始。
lines.en: Bed 12: two lists and a bag from home. Medication reconciliation, let's go.

lines.zh: 早上你換手圈的事，小組長跟我說了。系統裡乾乾淨淨。
lines.en: Ping told me about the wristband this morning. The system is spotless.

lines.zh: 乾淨的系統是停下來換來的。
lines.en: A clean system is what stopping buys you.

lines.zh: 藥局系統查到一筆手動覆寫的給藥。我們一起看是怎麼回事。
lines.en: Pharmacy picked up a manual override on a dose. Let's look at it together.

lines.zh: 7 床的手圈掃不過，我手動輸入了。
lines.en: Bed 7's band wouldn't scan. I typed it in.

lines.zh: 填一份異常通報。不是處罰，是讓系統學到。
lines.en: File an incident report. Not a punishment; it is how the system learns.

lines.zh: 兩份清單日期不同，家裡的藥袋又是第三個版本。從哪裡開始？
lines.en: The two lists have different dates and the bag from home is a third version. Where do we start?

post.zh: 開立、停用、實際使用，三欄。沒確認的，留空，不要猜。
post.en: Prescribed, stopped, actually taken: three columns. Anything unconfirmed stays blank; no guessing.

guide.en: Check the blood pressure at bed 12

sub.zh: 媽媽說頭暈，血壓量兩次不一樣
sub.en: Mum feels dizzy; two readings, two answers

lines.zh: 我用家裡的機器幫她量兩次，一次高一次低。哪個才對？
lines.en: I measured her twice with our machine, one high, one low. Which one is right?

lines.zh: 第一次量的時候，她剛做什麼？
lines.en: What was she doing just before the first reading?

lines.zh: 剛從廁所走回來。
lines.en: She'd just walked back from the toilet.

lines.zh: 我沒事，只是有點暈。
lines.en: I'm fine, just a little dizzy.

post.zh: 休息五分鐘、坐好、手臂與心臟同高、袖帶合尺寸，再量。兩個數字都記，條件也記。
post.en: Five minutes' rest, seated, arm at heart level, correctly sized cuff, then measure. Record both numbers and the conditions.

post.zh: 還有，她說暈。暈要回報，不是只重量到數字好看。
post.en: And she said dizzy. Dizzy gets reported; you don't just re-measure until the number looks nice.

note.zh: 模擬演練：每個人都有位置
note.en: Mock code: everyone has a place

lines.zh: 每月模擬急救，今天輪到我們。假設 12 床無反應。第一步？
lines.en: Monthly mock code, our turn today. Suppose bed 12 is unresponsive. First step?

lines.zh: 叫人、按鈴、推急救車。
lines.en: Call for help, hit the bell, get the crash cart.

lines.zh: 那車在哪裡？
lines.en: And where is the cart?

lines.zh: 演練時推車的人，真的時候也推車。
lines.en: Whoever pushes the cart in the drill pushes it for real.

q.zh: 找到急救車並檢查封條
q.en: Find the crash cart and check the seal

post.zh: 封條號碼和檢查表對得上。好。
post.en: Seal number matches the checklist. Good.

lines.zh: 位置、深度、節奏。假人會告訴你對不對。
lines.en: Position, depth, rate. The manikin will tell you.

post.zh: 手不離胸骨，兩分鐘換手，換手時間越短越好。
post.en: Hands stay on the sternum, swap every two minutes, and make the swap fast.

lines.zh: 檢討：叫人花了多久、車幾秒到、誰記時間、誰顧家屬。
lines.en: Debrief: how long to call, seconds to the cart, who kept time, who looked after the family.

lines.zh: 記時間的人沒有。
lines.en: Nobody kept the time.

lines.zh: 下次有了。每個人都有位置，包括拿筆的那個。
lines.en: Next time there will be. Everyone has a place, including the one with the pen.

lines.zh: 筆借我。
lines.en: Lend me your pen.

lines.zh: 監視器的警報在響。秀英姨呼吸變快，嘴唇顏色不對。
lines.en: The monitor alarm is sounding. Auntie Hsiu-Ying is breathing fast and her lips are the wrong colour.

lines.zh: 她剛剛還好好的！
lines.en: She was fine a minute ago!

options.zh: 坐起、看病人、依醫囑給氧、叫醫師、ISBAR
options.en: Sit her up, look at her, oxygen per order, call the doctor, ISBAR

why.zh: 先看人、再看機器；給氧依醫囑；回報要帶趨勢。
why.en: Patient before machine; oxygen per order; escalate with the trend.

options.zh: 把警報關掉再觀察幾分鐘
options.en: Silence the alarm and watch for a few minutes

why.zh: 關掉的是警報，不是問題。
why.en: You silenced the alarm, not the problem.

why.zh: 呼吸與血氧優先於其他數字。
why.en: Breathing and saturation come before any other number.

guide.zh: 向葉醫師 ISBAR 回報

lines.zh: 12 床秀英姨。情境：呼吸快、血氧下降。背景：今早 ICU 轉出。
lines.en: Bed 12, Auntie Hsiu-Ying. Situation: fast breathing, falling saturation. Background: transferred from ICU this morning.

lines.zh: 評估：三小時內血氧趨勢往下，右下肺呼吸音減弱。建議：請您看病人，依醫囑安排檢查。
lines.en: Assessment: saturation trending down over three hours, reduced breath sounds right base. Recommendation: please see her and order investigations.

lines.zh: 複誦：12 床、血氧下降趨勢、右下減弱。我看病人，開檢查。
lines.en: Read-back: bed 12, downward saturation trend, right base reduced. I'll examine her and order the tests.

lines.zh: 你剛剛講的是趨勢，不是最後一筆。
lines.en: You just gave him the trend, not the last reading.

note.zh: 交班：通知了誰、幾點、還有什麼沒做
note.en: Handover: who was told, when, and what remains

guide.en: Hand over to the evening shift

lines.zh: 交班三樣：你通知了誰、幾點、還有什麼沒做。
lines.en: Three things: who you told, when, and what is still open.

lines.zh: 12 床：血氧下降趨勢，十六點通知葉醫師，檢查已排，待結果；7 床：換藥完成，翻身表到十八點。
lines.en: Bed 12: downward saturation trend, Dr Yeh informed at sixteen hundred, tests ordered, results pending. Bed 7: dressing done, turning chart complete to eighteen hundred.

lines.zh: 這份交班，我願意接。
lines.en: That is a handover I'll take.

lines.zh: 今天四件事：趨勢不是最後一筆、停下來的三十秒、關鍵部位不碰、通知了誰要寫名字。
lines.en: Four things today: the trend is not the last reading, the thirty seconds you stop, never touch a key part, and name who you told.

lines.zh: 筆還你。
lines.en: Here's your pen back.

lines.zh: 她從口袋裡摸出自己的筆，看了一眼，沒說話。
lines.en: She finds her own pen in her pocket, looks at it, and says nothing.

lines.zh: 這個給你。
lines.en: This is for you.

lines.zh: 一隻紙鶴，用藥袋紙摺的，翅膀上印著「飯後」。
lines.en: A paper crane folded from a medicine bag; one wing says “after meals”.

lines.zh: 我放在護理站。明天換藥見。
lines.en: It's going on the station desk. See you at tomorrow's dressing.

note.zh: 夜裡看三樣：呼吸、點滴、床欄
note.en: At night, three things: breathing, drip, bed rails

sub.zh: 夜裡看三樣：呼吸、點滴、床欄
sub.en: At night, check three things: breathing, drip, bed rails

lines.zh: 手電筒照地不照臉。秀英姨睡著了，呼吸平穩，血氧回到她的趨勢線上。
lines.en: Torch on the floor, never the face. Auntie Hsiu-Ying is asleep, breathing evenly, her saturation back on its trend line.

lines.zh: 7 床的床頭櫃上，又多了一隻紙鶴。
lines.en: On the locker at bed 7, there is one more paper crane.

sub.zh: 停下來的三十秒，比什麼都值錢
sub.en: The thirty seconds you stop are worth the most
